description: Make or change the pro page of the person you act for (or this key's own): the page posters find and invite them by, on Pro Asks and across Asks. A handle, a name, a headline, what they do, a rate, links, availability (open means they can be invited to a pro ask; busy or closed, they are shown but not invited), and `listed`: public (the default, anyone can find the page) or private (off Asks and search; only someone who types the exact handle or address can invite them). Ask once, plainly, which they want. A private page can have a secret link (`share_link`: create, or replace to switch the old one off), said once on confirm. Previews by default; call again with confirm: true to sign. For guided setup, follow /pro/mcp.md#create-your-pro-profile on the matching Pro Asks host. Start with connect_linkedin: its verified profile pre-fills the name, headline, LinkedIn link and handle; ask for what LinkedIn lacks (the work they take, rate, availability, a line about them), then offer the rest one at a time in chat (photo, banner, location, skills, languages, experience, pictures) rather than sending them to the web form. This tool reads no site itself, so build the rest from what the person tells you or pastes. Spends nothing.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews; true signs and publishes.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

about.description: The summary, a few sentences in their words.

avatar.description: Their picture: a file on this machine (png, jpg or webp, up to 5 MB) or an https address. Uploaded for them; square works best.

banner.description: A wide picture across the top of the page: a file on this machine or an https address. About 3:1.

does.description: The board's words for what they do.

files.description: A CV or other documents, at https addresses.

handle.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 30, starting with a letter. The page's address: /pros/<handle>.

headline.description: One line: what they do, in their words.

listed.description: Public (true) or private (false): a private page is off Asks, the directory and search, and only someone who types the exact handle or address can invite them. Left out, the page keeps what it says now (public for a new page).

pictures.description: A portfolio: files on this machine or https addresses; each uploaded for them.

share_link.description: A private page's secret link: "create" makes one, "replace" makes a new one and switches the old one off. Said once, on confirm.

name: set_my_page
title: Write your pro page
